content: Nakoh-ci-Ndaŋkiyaah-ci
Mbaɗi, Kooh woyiɗ Israayel ci woo cii jen an :
« Ñam Nikiɗi, ñam Koohiŋ ɗa, mi yi pulɗoh ɗa Misra, ŋ ɗiska fu nikee ñaam.
Fu raakanɗi kooh wiiriis ɗal mi.
Fu haɓɗanɗi nataal fu ñaamkee ca. Ca nik ŋ in ci ŋ ɗafki, wala ca nik ciŋ kehƴi, wala sah ciŋ masmi ŋ ooɓ kehƴi.
Te fu heyɗi ca ƴekɗe, fu heyɗi ca ñaamke. Laam mi yi Nikiɗi Koohiŋ ɗa, ŋ teyɗukɗi ɓaah ɗa na in, ñam na mbugale kuɓuuciŋ baab ci sang ngo, na kuɓuuciŋ ɓeem, po ŋ set ca na setaat ca.
Ŋ teeɓohee keeñkohiŋ ngo po ŋ gomal junni (1000) ŋ ɓi waaɗ to, te ɓa haɓɗee in ci ŋ nakoh.
Fu heyɗi njirñiɗkohe tiikiŋ Nikiɗi Koohiŋ ɗa ŋ woo ɓarang ɓarang ; mi yi Nikiɗi, ŋ faɗanɗi ɓo' a njirñiɗkohee tiikiŋ ngo ŋ woo ɓarang ɓarang.
Ɗaakkoha nof mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse ne fu tuma mbeh hooliɗ wuu so.
Fu raakiɗ neeh yasna-yino ne fu haɓiɗ pangkiŋ ɗa nga jen.

Waaye mbehi yasna-kanakɗoh, weɗ wi na iɗsiɗkohse, yakɗoha Nikiɗi Koohiŋ ɗa. Fu heyɗi pangke nga, fu na kuɓuuciŋ ɗa, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ ; na ñaam ciŋ ɗa, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ ; na ɗoopaat ciŋ ɗa po ŋ jaambri gen kahan fu sah.
Laam, ngaŋ neeh yasna-yino, ŋ haɓɗiɗ eel ci na kehƴi na cookmi na in ci nik nga ca jen, ŋ faɗta mbehi yasna-kanakɗoh ŋ iɗsiɗukka nga, weɗ tah ŋ barke'iɗta mbeheem, ŋ tummbaa wuu so.
Eɗa yaay ɗu na baab ɗu cir ne fu min raak kipes hutiɗ ŋ kehƴa ŋ eɗan ɗa, mi yi Nikiɗi Koohiŋ ɗa.
Fu apanɗi ɓo'.
Fu njaaloo'anɗi.
Fu rokanɗi.
Fu woyɗanɗi morom fu ini a tumɗi.
Fu waaɗɗanɗi haf fu iniŋ morom fu, a kahan ce haa, ɓitiice haa, a ñaamiŋ ɗe ƴaar mbaa ɓitiɓ haa, a inoh fiŋ ɗe haa te a mbaamiŋ ɗe haa. »
Ŋ ndeem Israayel ca jen kerheeɗa inding ca na kuluɓ ka, ɓa nammba hot meleñ ca na findi tangoora ɗuukohe, ɓa saakɗoheeɗa sagu neƴƴoh ŋ ɗiska ɓa cangtiɗke.
Ɓa woosa Musaa ne : « Fu, woya na ɓoo, ɓoo hey ɗa sikɗuke, waaye Kooh kinaat woo na ɓoo jahran, ndaa ɓoo hey kaane. »
Musaa loffa ɓa ne : « Kinaat neƴƴoh, ini tah Kooh reɓ ndii, a na markiskee ɗu ne ɗu nup ɗe, ɗu bakaaɗuu. »
Israayel ca rissa ŋ ɗiska ɓa cangtiɗke, waaye Musaa reɓpa ŋ eela, ŋ ɗiska Kooh nike.
In ci Kooh nakoh ŋ seeƴkohaani
Wa Musaa reɓ, Nikiɗi woosa na ɗe woo cii, an : « Inii weɗ fu na hee woye Israayel ci : “ Ɗu hotootiɗ nga, ŋ woyoh na ɗu ŋ eel ci.
Ɗu heyɗi haɓɗe ali in wiiriis ñaamkaah ɓaat nga so, findi kooh ci nataal ci haɓɗohu urus wala haalis.

Ɗu na hee ɓaye merhey, ɗu haɓɗiɗ to seeƴkoha. Ɗu degan pe' ci, mbaal ci na inoh ci nga, ci hoomɗassan na ci seeƴkohsan wuu jam harmban ndo na ɗu. Te mi, ŋ hey haye ŋ barke'iɗ ɗu ŋ ɗisik ci ŋ teeɓohan jen ne mi yii nga.
Ɗu haɓɗiɗee so seeƴkoha na atoh ɗah, wa kinaat nik atoh pestuuɗ, ini ɗu na hee ca pestohe na ɓekee ca hoolaaɗi.
Kinaat to haɓɗiɗ seeƴkoha njooliɗ po ɓo' kee nga ɗah rapan rap, ineem na tahe tas-ɓarngiŋ ɗe hotuk. ” »
